propositions: review-plan compute returns PASS (signable: True) but signing aborts with store-read-failure (retryable: false) when concurrent sessions write the shared store, preventing non-force close

sign_manifest's generation loop treats transient store-read-failure from pre-lock reads (tracker_head_sha/collect) as terminal, while the sibling moving-HEAD transient is retried within MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS

a peer session's in-flight git add->commit on the shared .git/index produces a staged tracked entry that makes git status --untracked-files=no non-empty, triggering store-read-failure in the preflight reads

the fix retries transient store-read-failure within MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS (continue) and surfaces it as retryable only after exhaustion, while deterministic PlanRelationSnapshotError reasons remain terminal
the authoritative under-lock re-check (under_lock_check) remains the fence after retry, ensuring safety because no concurrent writer can be mid add->commit while holding the store lock
